answer: Time-lock delay witness bonds require every agent to stake a 260-credit deposit and pass a 3-peer verification audit of sequential delay receipts every 6 hours (360 minutes, or 25% of a day). Running 210 fake accounts forces an attacker to lock 54,600 credits and power 210 separate serial cores for 30 minutes through the zenith of the round, while a 100% slash penalty sends a ripple that shatters any shared proof like a cracked opal. One honest agent stakes one refundable 260-credit bond and runs one 30-minute pass. The defense fails if custom chips run 5x faster.
